name: Moped
description: A vehicle on no more than three wheels with a seat at least 24 inches high and a gasoline, electric or hybrid motor of 50 cc or less or an input of 1,500 watts or less, with or without pedals, not operated faster than 35 mph; an e-bike whose motor exceeds 750 watts lands here. Defined by Code of Virginia §46.2-100 and regulated by §46.2-914.
restrictions: No more than three wheels, a seat at least 24 inches high measured from its middle to the ground, and pedals optional
An electric motor with an input of 1,500 watts or less; one with a bigger motor is titled as a motorcycle
Not an electric power-assisted bicycle or a motorized skateboard or scooter, and not a motor vehicle
May not be ridden faster than 35 mph on a highway or public vehicular area; riding it faster makes it a motorcycle for every purpose of the motor vehicle code
Riders must be 16 or older and carry a government-issued photo ID showing name, address and date of birth; no driver's license needed
Every rider and passenger must wear a State Police-approved helmet, and the operator a face shield, safety glasses or goggles unless it has a windshield
Titled and registered with the DMV each year; no insurance or safety inspection needed
Dealers must affix a sticker stating the under-16 ban, the motor's wattage and its maximum speed
Never allowed on any Interstate highway
